title: Hister: A private search engine for the pages you visit and the files you keep
why_read: A local-first personal search tool for browsing history and files touches on a genuinely useful and technically interesting problem of private full-text indexing.
analysis: Hister appears to be a tool that indexes and searches your own browsing history and local files without sending data to a third party. Building a fast, private local search index that handles both web content and file content is a nontrivial engineering problem involving text extraction, indexing, and ranking. This kind of personal-data tool is appealing to privacy-conscious engineers, though its technical depth depends heavily on implementation details not visible from the title alone.
